The pressure-cam impact simultaneously claims roof-profile, three window-position, floor-level and dry-cassette capture, but the inventory provides no named window/floor registration anchors and no event for the cassette’s stated presentation, latch closure or retraction. Add registered anchors and a finite event chain so the stored dry state is visibly caused.","Shots 04 and 06 target only `left-keyed-roof-slot` while claiming that both roof keys are released. The registered `right-keyed-roof-slot` is never enrolled. Retarget the interaction to `rowhouse-facade` with both registered sockets, or declare separate supported releases.","Shot 04’s persistent house support uses the raw pseudo-anchor `rowhouse-facade base190,448`. That anchor is absent from the confirmed metadata inventory, so the facade/floor carriage relationship is not compilable through a registered binding. Add a named metadata anchor rather than relying on coordinates embedded in prose.","Shot 06 begins with the wet floor already attached to `floor-shuttle.wet-saddle`, but Shot 05 ends with only the live floor deformation established. The cut therefore hides a consequential support acquisition. Establish the persistent saddle beneath the floor in Shot 05, or show an explicit acquisition before transport.","Shot 06 restores the teal roof without a complete causal chain: there is no departure, handoff or motion-start event between its checkpoint-held state and landing at frame 84, and the claimed rollback-carriage left output has no named anchor in the inventory. The dominant rollback action therefore contains a self-starting component.","Shot 06’s frame-25 water event names the slug as actor and `rain-ribbon-anchor` as target, while its state text says the take-up cable owns the slug and is carrying it toward `test-water-reservoir`. Correct the actor, receiver and registered endpoint so ownership is unambiguous.","Shot 06 already consumes all eight temporal-evidence windows. Resolving its missing floor/roof interactions by merely adding contacts would exceed the contract limit; preserve those connections visibly from earlier shots or simplify/split the rollback choreography.","Shot 08 lands `paper-gold-history-strip` against `rowhouse-facade`, but the facade inventory contains only roof sockets and no underside archive-seat anchor. The ending fold needs a registered seat/contact anchor before it can compile as physical evidence.","The production-local focus/framing adapter is explicitly identified as agent-assisted, but its status is only “implemented, runtime pending” and it is not part of the supplied registered quality-binding list.
